mapper.sql: id, seat_code, seat_name, area_name, capacity, position_x, position_y, status, qr_version, qr_sign, sort, create_time, update_time, create_user, update_user
mapper.insert: insert into seat(seat_code, seat_name, area_name, capacity, position_x, position_y, status, qr_version, qr_sign, sort, create_time, update_time, create_user, update_user) values (#{seatCode}, #{seatName}, #{areaName}, #{capacity}, #{positionX}, #{positionY}, #{status}, #{qrVersion}, #{qrSign}, #{sort}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{createUser}, #{updateUser})
mapper.select:
select from seat
and area_name like concat('%', #{areaName}, '%')
and status = #{status}
and seat_code like concat('%', #{seatCode}, '%')
order by area_name, sort asc, create_time desc
mapper.update: update seat set status = #{status}, update_time = now() where id = #{id}
update seat set qr_version = #{qrVersion}, qr_sign = #{qrSign}, update_time = now() where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select from seat order by area_name, sort asc
select from seat where area_name = #{areaName} order by sort asc

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM seat) AS totalSeats, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM seat WHERE status = 'AVAILABLE') AS availableSeats, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM seat WHERE status = 'OCCUPIED') AS occupiedSeats, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM seat WHERE status = 'DISABLED') AS disabledSeats
select id, seat_id, status, start_time, close_time, create_time, update_time from dining_session where seat_id = #{seatId} and status = 'OPEN' order by start_time desc limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into dining_session(seat_id, status, start_time, create_time, update_time) values (#{seatId}, #{status}, #{startTime}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: update dining_session set status = 'CLOSED', close_time = now(), update_time = now() where id = #{id}
